title: Triangle inequality for the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and all α, γ ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n: |α + γ| ≤ |α| + |γ|. Here |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm, i.e. |α| = √(Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P} [I strictly increasing]·α(b_{I(0)}, …, b_{I(n−1)})²) with b_i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α γ : Covector (Eucl P) n), covectorEuclideanNorm (α + γ) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α + covectorEuclideanNorm γ
